description: This file defines the CookieJar class which manages HTTP cookies, including storing, retrieving, filtering, and setting cookies, as well as handling cookie persistence and domain/path matching.

classes.name: CookieJar
classes.description: A class that manages a collection of cookies, allowing adding, removing, filtering, and retrieving cookies, as well as handling cookie persistence and domain/path matching.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the CookieJar with optional strict mode and an array of SetCookie objects.

methods.name: fromArray
methods.description: Creates a CookieJar from an associative array of cookies and a domain.

methods.name: shouldPersist
methods.description: Determines if a cookie should be persisted based on its expiration and discard flags.

methods.name: getCookieByName
methods.description: Retrieves a cookie by its name.

methods.name: toArray
methods.description: Returns all cookies as an array.

methods.name: clear
methods.description: Removes cookies based on domain, path, and name filters.

methods.name: setCookie
methods.description: Adds or updates a cookie in the jar after validation.

methods.name: getIterator
methods.description: Returns an iterator over the cookies.

methods.name: extractCookies
methods.description: Extracts cookies from HTTP response headers and adds them to the jar.

methods.name: getCookiePathFromRequest
methods.description: Computes the cookie path based on the request URI following RFC 6265.

methods.name: withCookieHeader
methods.description: Adds appropriate Cookie header to a request based on stored cookies.

methods.name: removeCookieIfEmpty
methods.description: Removes a cookie if its value is null or empty.
